props.evaluation_reason: LEGZ first estimates the player’s expected next-game output from an L5-primary statistical spectrum, stabilized by L10/full-L15 evidence, then evaluates the exact offered threshold against that shared forecast distribution. Executable POM price is the preferred bounded market prior; when a DFS/pick’em POM has no native straight-bet price, independently verified SportsGameOdds no-vig fair probability may supply the secondary market prior. Cross-book consensus, exact-book confirmations and line disagreement remain market evidence and never mint LJPC without player-performance evidence. JINX challenges the forecast with attributable role, availability, opponent, injury, weather, game-plan and Analyst Desk evidence. JINX also applies a bounded anti-recency/mean-reversion caution when a pick simply extends a materially displaced L5 hot/cold streak; this is not a claim that a player is due. Narrative reporting never creates a directional adjustment without structured evidence. The LSI Signal Fabric may recognize sequence, correlation, conditional-recipe and regime-change patterns, but newly discovered recipe adjustments remain shadow-only until empirical learning-gate promotion authorizes live influence.

articles.headline: Jayden Daniels, Commanders 'keep fighting through adversity,' improve to 2-4-1
articles.summary: After falling behind 10-0 in the first half, quarterback Jayden Daniels led the Washington Commanders on a rousing rally, cruising to a 27-10 win over the Philadelphia Eagles at Northwest Stadium, an effort in which he threw for 217 yards and a touchdown.

articles.headline: Saquon Barkley has assurances he won't be dealt, wants to help Eagles 'fix it'
articles.summary: Speaking after Sunday night's 27-10 loss to the Washington Commanders, Philadelphia Eagles running back Saquon Barkley told reporters he has received assurances from the front office that he will remain with the club beyond the Nov. 10 trade deadline.

articles.headline: Jayden Daniels, Commanders 'keep fighting through adversity,' improve to 2-4-1
articles.summary: After falling behind 10-0 in the first half, quarterback Jayden Daniels led the Washington Commanders on a rousing rally, cruising to a 27-10 win over the Philadelphia Eagles at Northwest Stadium, an effort in which he threw for 217 yards and a touchdown.

articles.headline: Saquon Barkley has assurances he won't be dealt, wants to help Eagles 'fix it'
articles.summary: Speaking after Sunday night's 27-10 loss to the Washington Commanders, Philadelphia Eagles running back Saquon Barkley told reporters he has received assurances from the front office that he will remain with the club beyond the Nov. 10 trade deadline.

articles.headline: Jayden Daniels throws TD pass and Commanders shut out Eagles over final 3 quarters in 27-10 win
articles.summary: — The Washington Commanders had just under two weeks to sit with their disheartening start to the season before their matchup against the Philadelphia Eagles on Sunday night.

articles.headline: Jayden Daniels, Commanders 'keep fighting through adversity,' improve to 2-4-1
articles.summary: After falling behind 10-0 in the first half, quarterback Jayden Daniels led the Washington Commanders on a rousing rally, cruising to a 27-10 win over the Philadelphia Eagles at Northwest Stadium, an effort in which he threw for 217 yards and a touchdown.

articles.headline: Saquon Barkley has assurances he won't be dealt, wants to help Eagles 'fix it'
articles.summary: Speaking after Sunday night's 27-10 loss to the Washington Commanders, Philadelphia Eagles running back Saquon Barkley told reporters he has received assurances from the front office that he will remain with the club beyond the Nov. 10 trade deadline.

articles.headline: Jayden Daniels throws TD pass and Commanders shut out Eagles over final 3 quarters in 27-10 win
articles.summary: — The Washington Commanders had just under two weeks to sit with their disheartening start to the season before their matchup against the Philadelphia Eagles on Sunday night.

props.evaluation_reason: LEGZ first estimates the player’s expected next-game output from an L5-primary statistical spectrum, stabilized by L10/full-L15 evidence, then evaluates the exact offered threshold against that shared forecast distribution. Executable POM price is the preferred bounded market prior; when a DFS/pick’em POM has no native straight-bet price, independently verified SportsGameOdds no-vig fair probability may supply the secondary market prior. Cross-book consensus, exact-book confirmations and line disagreement remain market evidence and never mint LJPC without player-performance evidence. JINX challenges the forecast with attributable role, availability, opponent, injury, weather, game-plan and Analyst Desk evidence. JINX also applies a bounded anti-recency/mean-reversion caution when a pick simply extends a materially displaced L5 hot/cold streak; this is not a claim that a player is due. Narrative reporting never creates a directional adjustment without structured evidence. The LSI Signal Fabric may recognize sequence, correlation, conditional-recipe and regime-change patterns, but newly discovered recipe adjustments remain shadow-only until empirical learning-gate promotion authorizes live influence.
props.evidence_summary: Exact offered retail POM observed through ParlayAPI on Underdog; primary execution/source expression: Underdog.

Executable POM price is the preferred bounded market prior; when a DFS/pick’em POM has no native straight-bet price, independently verified SportsGameOdds no-vig fair probability may supply the secondary market prior. Cross-book consensus, exact-book confirmations and line disagreement remain market evidence and never mint LJPC without player-performance evidence. JINX challenges the forecast with attributable role, availability, opponent, injury, weather, game-plan and Analyst Desk evidence. JINX also applies a bounded anti-recency/mean-reversion caution when a pick simply extends a materially displaced L5 hot/cold streak; this is not a claim that a player is due. Narrative reporting never creates a directional adjustment without structured evidence. props.evaluation_reason: LEGZ first estimates the player’s expected next-game output from an L5-primary statistical spectrum, stabilized by L10/full-L15 evidence, then evaluates the exact offered threshold against that shared forecast distribution. Executable POM price is the preferred bounded market prior; when a DFS/pick’em POM has no native straight-bet price, independently verified SportsGameOdds no-vig fair probability may supply the secondary market prior. Cross-book consensus, exact-book confirmations and line disagreement remain market evidence and never mint LJPC without player-performance evidence. JINX challenges the forecast with attributable role, availability, opponent, injury, weather, game-plan and Analyst Desk evidence. JINX also applies a bounded anti-recency/mean-reversion caution when a pick simply extends a materially displaced L5 hot/cold streak; this is not a claim that a player is due. Narrative reporting never creates a directional adjustment without structured evidence. The LSI Signal Fabric may recognize sequence, correlation, conditional-recipe and regime-change patterns, but newly discovered recipe adjustments remain shadow-only until empirical learning-gate promotion authorizes live influence.

JINX also applies a bounded anti-recency/mean-reversion caution when a pick simply extends a materially displaced L5 hot/cold streak; this is not a claim that a player is due. Narrative reporting never creates a directional adjustment without structured evidence. props.evaluation_reason: LEGZ first estimates the player’s expected next-game output from an L5-primary statistical spectrum, stabilized by L10/full-L15 evidence, then evaluates the exact offered threshold against that shared forecast distribution. Executable POM price is the preferred bounded market prior; when a DFS/pick’em POM has no native straight-bet price, independently verified SportsGameOdds no-vig fair probability may supply the secondary market prior. Cross-book consensus, exact-book confirmations and line disagreement remain market evidence and never mint LJPC without player-performance evidence. JINX challenges the forecast with attributable role, availability, opponent, injury, weather, game-plan and Analyst Desk evidence. JINX also applies a bounded anti-recency/mean-reversion caution when a pick simply extends a materially displaced L5 hot/cold streak; this is not a claim that a player is due. Narrative reporting never creates a directional adjustment without structured evidence. The LSI Signal Fabric may recognize sequence, correlation, conditional-recipe and regime-change patterns, but newly discovered recipe adjustments remain shadow-only until empirical learning-gate promotion authorizes live influence.

props.evaluation_reason: LEGZ first estimates the player’s expected next-game output from an L5-primary statistical spectrum, stabilized by L10/full-L15 evidence, then evaluates the exact offered threshold against that shared forecast distribution. Executable POM price is the preferred bounded market prior; when a DFS/pick’em POM has no native straight-bet price, independently verified SportsGameOdds no-vig fair probability may supply the secondary market prior. Cross-book consensus, exact-book confirmations and line disagreement remain market evidence and never mint LJPC without player-performance evidence. JINX challenges the forecast with attributable role, availability, opponent, injury, weather, game-plan and Analyst Desk evidence. JINX also applies a bounded anti-recency/mean-reversion caution when a pick simply extends a materially displaced L5 hot/cold streak; this is not a claim that a player is due. Narrative reporting never creates a directional adjustment without structured evidence. The LSI Signal Fabric may recognize sequence, correlation, conditional-recipe and regime-change patterns, but newly discovered recipe adjustments remain shadow-only until empirical learning-gate promotion authorizes live influence.
props.evidence_summary: Exact offered retail POM observed through ParlayAPI on Underdog; primary execution/source expression: Underdog.

Executable POM price is the preferred bounded market prior; when a DFS/pick’em POM has no native straight-bet price, independently verified SportsGameOdds no-vig fair probability may supply the secondary market prior. Cross-book consensus, exact-book confirmations and line disagreement remain market evidence and never mint LJPC without player-performance evidence. JINX challenges the forecast with attributable role, availability, opponent, injury, weather, game-plan and Analyst Desk evidence. JINX also applies a bounded anti-recency/mean-reversion caution when a pick simply extends a materially displaced L5 hot/cold streak; this is not a claim that a player is due. Narrative reporting never creates a directional adjustment without structured evidence. The LSI Signal Fabric may recognize sequence, correlation, conditional-recipe and regime-change patterns, but newly discovered recipe adjustments remain shadow-only until empirical learning-gate promotion authorizes live influence.

props.evaluation_reason: LEGZ first estimates the player’s expected next-game output from an L5-primary statistical spectrum, stabilized by L10/full-L15 evidence, then evaluates the exact offered threshold against that shared forecast distribution. Executable POM price is the preferred bounded market prior; when a DFS/pick’em POM has no native straight-bet price, independently verified SportsGameOdds no-vig fair probability may supply the secondary market prior. Cross-book consensus, exact-book confirmations and line disagreement remain market evidence and never mint LJPC without player-performance evidence. JINX challenges the forecast with attributable role, availability, opponent, injury, weather, game-plan and Analyst Desk evidence. JINX also applies a bounded anti-recency/mean-reversion caution when a pick simply extends a materially displaced L5 hot/cold streak; this is not a claim that a player is due. Narrative reporting never creates a directional adjustment without structured evidence. The LSI Signal Fabric may recognize sequence, correlation, conditional-recipe and regime-change patterns, but newly discovered recipe adjustments remain shadow-only until empirical learning-gate promotion authorizes live influence.

props.evaluation_reason: LEGZ first estimates the player’s expected next-game output from an L5-primary statistical spectrum, stabilized by L10/full-L15 evidence, then evaluates the exact offered threshold against that shared forecast distribution. Executable POM price is the preferred bounded market prior; when a DFS/pick’em POM has no native straight-bet price, independently verified SportsGameOdds no-vig fair probability may supply the secondary market prior. Cross-book consensus, exact-book confirmations and line disagreement remain market evidence and never mint LJPC without player-performance evidence. JINX challenges the forecast with attributable role, availability, opponent, injury, weather, game-plan and Analyst Desk evidence. JINX also applies a bounded anti-recency/mean-reversion caution when a pick simply extends a materially displaced L5 hot/cold streak; this is not a claim that a player is due. Narrative reporting never creates a directional adjustment without structured evidence. The LSI Signal Fabric may recognize sequence, correlation, conditional-recipe and regime-change patterns, but newly discovered recipe adjustments remain shadow-only until empirical learning-gate promotion authorizes live influence.
props.evidence_summary: Exact offered retail POM observed through ParlayAPI on Underdog; primary execution/source expression: Underdog.

Executable POM price is the preferred bounded market prior; when a DFS/pick’em POM has no native straight-bet price, independently verified SportsGameOdds no-vig fair probability may supply the secondary market prior. Cross-book consensus, exact-book confirmations and line disagreement remain market evidence and never mint LJPC without player-performance evidence. JINX challenges the forecast with attributable role, availability, opponent, injury, weather, game-plan and Analyst Desk evidence. JINX also applies a bounded anti-recency/mean-reversion caution when a pick simply extends a materially displaced L5 hot/cold streak; this is not a claim that a player is due. Narrative reporting never creates a directional adjustment without structured evidence. The LSI Signal Fabric may recognize sequence, correlation, conditional-recipe and regime-change patterns, but newly discovered recipe adjustments remain shadow-only until empirical learning-gate promotion authorizes live influence.
props.evidence_summary: Exact offered retail POM observed through ParlayAPI on DraftKings, Underdog; primary execution/source expression: DraftKings.

articles.headline: Heat's Klay Thompson hits eight 3s, but none as dramatic as game winner
articles.summary: The Heat engulfed Klay Thompson in a jubilant celebration after his corner 3 -- his eighth of the game -- went in with one second left in overtime of Miami's 117-116 victory over the Clippers.

articles.headline: Klay Thompson hits winning 3 with a second left in OT as Heat rally past skidding Clippers 117-116
articles.summary: — Klay Thompson made the winning 3-pointer with a second left in overtime and the Miami Heat rallied past the reeling Los Angeles Clippers 117-116 on Wednesday night.

props.evaluation_reason: LEGZ first estimates the player’s expected next-game output from an L5-primary statistical spectrum, stabilized by L10/full-L15 evidence, then evaluates the exact offered threshold against that shared forecast distribution. Executable POM price is the preferred bounded market prior; when a DFS/pick’em POM has no native straight-bet price, independently verified SportsGameOdds no-vig fair probability may supply the secondary market prior. Cross-book consensus, exact-book confirmations and line disagreement remain market evidence and never mint LJPC without player-performance evidence. JINX challenges the forecast with attributable role, availability, opponent, injury, weather, game-plan and Analyst Desk evidence. JINX also applies a bounded anti-recency/mean-reversion caution when a pick simply extends a materially displaced L5 hot/cold streak; this is not a claim that a player is due. Narrative reporting never creates a directional adjustment without structured evidence. The LSI Signal Fabric may recognize sequence, correlation, conditional-recipe and regime-change patterns, but newly discovered recipe adjustments remain shadow-only until empirical learning-gate promotion authorizes live influence.

player_projection.forecast_policy: L5-primary expected output; L10 and full L15 stabilize; exact offered threshold evaluated against one shared player-game forecast. Provider market labels remain separate from LSI statistical line profile.

L5-primary expected output; L10 and full L15 stabilize; exact offered threshold evaluated against one shared player-game forecast. Provider market labels remain separate from LSI statistical line profile.

props.evaluation_reason: LEGZ first estimates the player’s expected next-game output from an L5-primary statistical spectrum, stabilized by L10/full-L15 evidence, then evaluates the exact offered threshold against that shared forecast distribution. Executable POM price is the preferred bounded market prior; when a DFS/pick’em POM has no native straight-bet price, independently verified SportsGameOdds no-vig fair probability may supply the secondary market prior. Cross-book consensus, exact-book confirmations and line disagreement remain market evidence and never mint LJPC without player-performance evidence. JINX challenges the forecast with attributable role, availability, opponent, injury, weather, game-plan and Analyst Desk evidence. JINX also applies a bounded anti-recency/mean-reversion caution when a pick simply extends a materially displaced L5 hot/cold streak; this is not a claim that a player is due. Narrative reporting never creates a directional adjustment without structured evidence. The LSI Signal Fabric may recognize sequence, correlation, conditional-recipe and regime-change patterns, but newly discovered recipe adjustments remain shadow-only until empirical learning-gate promotion authorizes live influence.

Executable POM price is the preferred bounded market prior; when a DFS/pick’em POM has no native straight-bet price, independently verified SportsGameOdds no-vig fair probability may supply the secondary market prior. Cross-book consensus, exact-book confirmations and line disagreement remain market evidence and never mint LJPC without player-performance evidence. JINX challenges the forecast with attributable role, availability, opponent, injury, weather, game-plan and Analyst Desk evidence. JINX also applies a bounded anti-recency/mean-reversion caution when a pick simply extends a materially displaced L5 hot/cold streak; this is not a claim that a player is due. Narrative reporting never creates a directional adjustment without structured evidence. The LSI Signal Fabric may recognize sequence, correlation, conditional-recipe and regime-change patterns, but newly discovered recipe adjustments remain shadow-only until empirical learning-gate promotion authorizes live influence.

props.evaluation_reason: LEGZ first estimates the player’s expected next-game output from an L5-primary statistical spectrum, stabilized by L10/full-L15 evidence, then evaluates the exact offered threshold against that shared forecast distribution. Executable POM price is the preferred bounded market prior; when a DFS/pick’em POM has no native straight-bet price, independently verified SportsGameOdds no-vig fair probability may supply the secondary market prior. Cross-book consensus, exact-book confirmations and line disagreement remain market evidence and never mint LJPC without player-performance evidence. JINX challenges the forecast with attributable role, availability, opponent, injury, weather, game-plan and Analyst Desk evidence. JINX also applies a bounded anti-recency/mean-reversion caution when a pick simply extends a materially displaced L5 hot/cold streak; this is not a claim that a player is due. Narrative reporting never creates a directional adjustment without structured evidence. The LSI Signal Fabric may recognize sequence, correlation, conditional-recipe and regime-change patterns, but newly discovered recipe adjustments remain shadow-only until empirical learning-gate promotion authorizes live influence.

props.evaluation_reason: LEGZ first estimates the player’s expected next-game output from an L5-primary statistical spectrum, stabilized by L10/full-L15 evidence, then evaluates the exact offered threshold against that shared forecast distribution. Executable POM price is the preferred bounded market prior; when a DFS/pick’em POM has no native straight-bet price, independently verified SportsGameOdds no-vig fair probability may supply the secondary market prior. Cross-book consensus, exact-book confirmations and line disagreement remain market evidence and never mint LJPC without player-performance evidence. JINX challenges the forecast with attributable role, availability, opponent, injury, weather, game-plan and Analyst Desk evidence. JINX also applies a bounded anti-recency/mean-reversion caution when a pick simply extends a materially displaced L5 hot/cold streak; this is not a claim that a player is due. Narrative reporting never creates a directional adjustment without structured evidence. The LSI Signal Fabric may recognize sequence, correlation, conditional-recipe and regime-change patterns, but newly discovered recipe adjustments remain shadow-only until empirical learning-gate promotion authorizes live influence.

player_projection.forecast_policy: L5-primary expected output; L10 and full L15 stabilize; exact offered threshold evaluated against one shared player-game forecast. Provider market labels remain separate from LSI statistical line profile.

L5-primary expected output; L10 and full L15 stabilize; exact offered threshold evaluated against one shared player-game forecast. Provider market labels remain separate from LSI statistical line profile.

props.evaluation_reason: LEGZ first estimates the player’s expected next-game output from an L5-primary statistical spectrum, stabilized by L10/full-L15 evidence, then evaluates the exact offered threshold against that shared forecast distribution. Executable POM price is the preferred bounded market prior; when a DFS/pick’em POM has no native straight-bet price, independently verified SportsGameOdds no-vig fair probability may supply the secondary market prior. Cross-book consensus, exact-book confirmations and line disagreement remain market evidence and never mint LJPC without player-performance evidence. JINX challenges the forecast with attributable role, availability, opponent, injury, weather, game-plan and Analyst Desk evidence. JINX also applies a bounded anti-recency/mean-reversion caution when a pick simply extends a materially displaced L5 hot/cold streak; this is not a claim that a player is due. Narrative reporting never creates a directional adjustment without structured evidence. The LSI Signal Fabric may recognize sequence, correlation, conditional-recipe and regime-change patterns, but newly discovered recipe adjustments remain shadow-only until empirical learning-gate promotion authorizes live influence.
props.evidence_summary: Exact offered retail POM observed through ParlayAPI on Underdog; primary execution/source expression: Underdog.
